Administrative Services

Office of The Registrar

The Office of the Registrar at BUBT serves as the central hub for academic records, course registration, and student services.

Room: 213, Floor: 1, Building: 1, BUBT Main Campur

About the Office

The Office of the Registrar at BUBT manages academic records, course registration, and essential student services. It ensures the accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality of student information while supporting academic operations in accordance with university policies and regulations.

Services of Our Office

Course Registration

Managing both online and in-person semester registration processes to ensure accurate course enrollment in compliance with academic regulations.

Transcript Issuance

Preparing and issuing official academic transcripts upon request, maintaining accuracy, confidentiality, and institutional authenticity.

Certificate & Degree Delivery

Processing and delivering official certificates and degrees following successful academic completion and formal approval procedures.

Exam Scheduling

Preparing, coordinating, and publishing examination timetables in consultation with academic departments to ensure smooth conduct of examinations.
